abi.entrypoint: vLLM offline LLM API with an equivalent online-serving execution route

computation.definition: Run the frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B AutoRound GPTQ W4A16 group-128 checkpoint autoregressively through vLLM V1. Execute every transformer layer, recurrent and KV-cache update, output projection and greedy token selection for exactly 64 output tokens per request.
dependencies: each output token depends on the complete recurrent and KV state from preceding tokens
all linear-attention, full-attention and MLP projections remain enabled
candidate changes must preserve the frozen integer weights, group scales, BF16 activation contract and token sequence
forbidden_rewrites: changing GPTQ weights, scales or group size
changing sampling, output-head shortlist or generated-token count
speculative decoding, token pruning, skipped layers or early exit
using FP16 activations in place of BF16
legal_rewrites: persistent scheduling, launch amortization and overlap that preserve lifetimes
CUDA Graph-compatible routing by active batch

inputs.layout: one contiguous token-ID row per request
inputs.name: input_ids

numerics.acceptance: Every frozen natural prompt must produce exactly the same 64 greedy token IDs. Candidate weights and scales must retain their source bit patterns.
numerics.accumulation_dtype: implementation-defined where stock vLLM permits it; observable output remains exact
numerics.reference: vLLM V1 stock execution selected by lm_head=torch at guarded source commit 4048b5edbad29bed0d052c6e258fd1c53072218f.

source_identity.qualification_requirement: Any retained candidate must be rebuilt and revalidated in a separate clean-upstream environment before upstream packaging.
